units.CD9106-demba: Demba territory (Kasaï-Central) comprises the Demba, Bena Leka and Mutoto secteurs with Demba town as chief town. It was part of the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu insurgency theatre, which FARDC operations crushed; most militiamen surrendered in 2019. No armed group is known to hold territory as of 2026: Demba town and secteur centres are policed by the PNC with FARDC and ANR present, and villages fall under PNC posts and customary chiefs. Assessment relies on background knowledge because live web research was unavailable in this run, so confidence is limited.
